card.name: Once every so often
card.fires_on: The word "once" (or words just before it) in phrases about rare recurrence, such as "once every decade" or "once in a while". It also fires on linking words like "in" or "a" inside these phrases.

modes.label: Once before a long interval
modes.description: "once" followed by an expected "every N years" style span.

modes.label: Lead-in to rare occurrence
modes.description: Words like "occurs" or "only" that set up "once every...".
modes.example: a massive nationwide survey that<< occurs>> only once every decade.

modes.label: Inside once-in phrases
modes.description: Small words within "once in a while" or "once in every thousand".
modes.example: Every once in<< a>> while it is worth pausing to reconsider

card.writes: It promotes words meaning once, rare, rarity and "every" or "lifetime" in English and Chinese, which favors completing rare-frequency phrases.
card.plain: It spots wording about something that happens only once in a long while.
